name: GetYouTubeTranscript API Sign-up Credits
free_limit: 100 one-time credits on account sign-up for the YouTube transcript REST API and hosted MCP server; 1 credit per successful transcript, search, channel or playlist request, and failed requests are not charged.
watch_out: Not a recurring monthly allowance: once the 100 sign-up credits are used, API access needs a paid plan or top-up credits. Sign-up credits can be withheld from accounts flagged for repeated sign-ups. Reselling the API as a competing product or sharing API keys is not allowed under the terms.
